why: THE CENSUS, not an exemption. Every entry is a client path that DESTROYS a row in a registered soft-deletable entity table - the exact defect DD-119 closed for workspace.tasks (db-rules FEATURE.md sections 8 and 8a). They are listed so the gate can fail on NEW offenders instead of being ignored, and every entry is work somebody owns. Remove an entry the moment its path moves to a soft delete; a stale entry FAILS the gate too.
measured: 2026-09-12, matrx-frontend, against the live soft-deletable population on brsgrqvjdzwihsvnfqkf.
serverLane: app/api/** is deliberately not scanned: those routes run as service_role, the lane that IS allowed to destroy a row. Its .delete() calls are outside this census.
